messages:
lin: quick accessibility note from QA on the Run > Presets flow — keyboard users are losing place after saving a preset. VoiceOver reads an update but visual focus disappears.
maria: can you paste the exact steps?
lin: repro: Run panel -> Presets -> Edit -> Save. After Save the hidden `.sr-note` receives focus to trigger narration; sighted keyboard users land on a non-visible element.
chris: we used that pattern originally to guarantee SR announcement. looks like we need a better approach.
a11y-bot: checklist: 1) do not programmatically focus visually-hidden live nodes; 2) ensure updated preset row gets focus; 3) visible focus styles for pills/rows; 4) preset badges meet AA contrast.
sam: suggested fix: keep message in an aria-live region (role="status") and programmatically focus the updated preset row (set tabindex="-1" then call .focus()). that preserves SR reading and visible focus.
maria: also revert any CSS that removed outlines on `.pill:focus`. use a high-contrast focus ring (2px solid + subtle shadow) that meets contrast on all themes.
lin: color check: preset badge text falls to ~3.8:1 in dim theme. propose swapping to `--brand-600` for bg and `#061114` for text to get >=4.5:1.
chris: ARIA improvement: make the presets container `role="list"` with `aria-label="Presets"` and add `aria-posinset`/`aria-setsize` on each item so screen reader users know position.
a11y-bot: keyboard tests to add: modal open -> tab into controls -> save -> focus returned to updated row; arrow keys navigate preset list; Esc closes modal and returns focus.
maria: please include unit test for focus return (jsdom focus mock) and an Axe run in CI. add VoiceOver/TalkBack notes in PR for manual check.
sam: i'll attach contrast screenshots and a short VoiceOver note.
lin: thanks, small changes but much better for keyboard+SR folks. :thumbsup:
